textbookBox.concept: Standing in the heart of the capital is a place where a flame burns day and night to remember brave people. This short poem takes you to that place, the National War Memorial in New Delhi.

textbookBox.concept: The National War Memorial in New Delhi was established in February 2019. It is a national monument built by the Government of India in honour of our brave soldiers.
